svg.title: Quiet native SVG knob
svg.desc: A single illustrated knob moves between two differently colored states.
svg.metadata: Rebuilt from 旋钮在左.png and 旋钮在右.png. Static shell, state backgrounds, avatar frame, avatar artwork and background decorations are separate semantic layers.
